per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked DBAASP assay rows and duplicate DBAASP experiment rows were source-verified against Table 2. CAMP title mismatches and three literature-only DBAASP IDs are preserved as cautions instead of forced acceptance.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML Table 2 yields a complete row/column MBC matrix with target species, strains, μM units, method conditions, and locators. ND cells remain nonquantitative primary results.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism ontology is bounded to directly assayed membrane permeability/polarity plus cautious interpretation; unsupported RNA-synthesis speculation is not promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: The original open ticket was resolved by source review; no blocking or major issue remains, but database and figure-quantification cautions make the final accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Five CAMP/dbAMP-style summary rows carry incomplete or conflicting entity names while their activity values map to primary Table 2; they remain source_conflict, not source_verified.
Three DBAASP literature-only IDs cite this paper but lack local linked sequence or assay rows; retained as database_only_no_primary_source.
Primary Table 2 ND cells are represented as nonquantitative not-detected MBC results up to 50 μM rather than omitted or normalized.
The XML metadata has no supplement flag; landed supplementary .bin files are HTML article landing/full-text pages and do not provide additional activity/toxicity tables.
Mechanism claims use source text/figure captions and do not fabricate numeric figure series.
